# Solitaire (adapted)

- Upstream: https://github.com/AashishChakravarty/solitaire
- Author: Aashish Chakravarty
- Revision: `f26b5c54eb260546b3eb1eabdbc6e83f361af42f`
- Retrieved: 2026-07-22
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The adapted single-page application is distributed as
`content/applications/solitaire.html`. Its Klondike game rules, state model,
scoring, hints, undo, auto-complete and drag/drop interactions derive from the
upstream HTML application. ClackOS adds its own application chrome, responsive
layout, palette variables, author/licence UI, and a fix for preserving the
pre-move state used by undo.

No upstream runtime assets or network services are required.
